title: The Listening Choir
author: Cyrus Quintana
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
